Lemma
1. Lemma 1.33\group harmonic-functions Source: han-lin-lecture-notes:page-0022 If $u>0$ is harmonic in $B_1$, then \[ \sup _{B_{1/2}}|D\log u|\le c(n). \]
Proof

\sketch Set $v=\log u$ and $w=|Dv|^2$. Then $\Delta v=-w$ and $\Delta w+2Dv\cdot Dw=2|D^2v|^2\ge 2w^2/n$. Applying the maximum principle to $\eta ^4w$ for a cutoff $\eta $ equal to one on $B_{1/2}$ yields a uniform bound.

□
